description.value: Mythology is a boutique winery and distillery near Osoyoos in BC's South Okanagan, producing a range of reds, whites, rosés, and craft spirits including brandy, vodka, and gin. Visitors can book a guided tasting in the vineyard-side tasting room or linger in the pet-friendly picnic grounds over wine and charcuterie. The property also includes the Sonora Desert Inn, offering overnight accommodation surrounded by vineyard-lined hills and Okanagan valley views.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Mythology is an operational winery, distillery, and inn near Osoyoos, BC, with a tasting room, picnic grounds, and on-site inn (Sonora Desert Inn). The contact page confirms the OSM address (10238 160th Ave, Osoyoos, BC V0H 1V2) and primary phone (778-879-6065), though a second phone number (604-862-3420) appears in the footer. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities, so those are all null.
concerns: Website contact page states 'We are closed for the season' with winter appointments by arrangement — business is seasonal; verify operating season before publishing.
Two different phone numbers appear on the website: 778-879-6065 in the main contact section (matches OSM) and 604-862-3420 in the page footer — source of the second number is unclear.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating winery, distillery, and inn near Osoyoos with confirmed website and contact details; a natural stop for cyclists exploring Okanagan wine country.
